comparison.objective: Re-sort six bottles between crowded shelf levels while preserving every neighboring bottle.
comparison.physical_skill: Horizontal constrained extraction, staging, replacement, and multi-object collision avoidance versus small-tool engagement and tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Requires all bottles on color-matched shelves, stable for two seconds, with irreversible fall/tilt/workspace failures; no damping criterion. Rubric is complete.
comparison.reason: Crowded multi-object sorting is a different tested manipulation family from commissioning an adjustable shock absorber.
